# S1.1 — DSFB-GPU-Atlas detector algebra report (type surface only)
#
# Generated by: dsfb-gpu-atlas-registry at S1.1.
# Hardware:     RTX 4080 SUPER (no GPU execution in this commit).
# Date:         2026-05-15.
# Scope:        TYPE SURFACE ONLY.
#               NO registry generation.
#               NO corpus_hash_v1.
#               NO CaseFileV2.
#               NO GPU execution.
#               NO publication-grade claims.
#
# This report is the human-readable mirror of the S1.1
# `dsfb-gpu-atlas-registry` crate. It enumerates the algebra
# coordinates, the panel-recommended family seed, the pin-locked
# defaults, and the explicit deferral statements.

================================================================
Section 1 — Algebra grammar
================================================================

Panel-locked detector grammar:

  Detector = LiteraturePrimitive
           × ParameterGrid
           × Transform
           × Window
           × Comparator
           × Gate
           -> DetectorSpec

Canonical wire-name format:

  {FAMILY}__{TRANSFORM}__W{WINDOW}__{STATISTIC}__{COMPARATOR}__P{PERSISTENCE}

Examples:

  ROBUST_Z_MAD__RESIDUAL__W64__MAD__TWO_SIDED__P3
  EWMA__RESIDUAL__W32__MEAN__HIGH__P2
  CUSUM__DRIFT__W64__SUM__HIGH__P4

Token boundary: exact string `__` (double underscore).
Tokens are uppercase snake-case. Pinned by acceptance tests
`canonical_name_is_stable`,
`canonical_name_uses_double_underscore_boundaries`, and
`family_canonical_wire_names_are_uppercase_snake_case`.

================================================================
Section 2 — Seeded DetectorFamily variants
================================================================

S1.1 seeds 43 detector families across the panel-named domains:

  Statistical process control (8):
    Shewhart, WesternElectric, NelsonRules, Ewma, Cusum,
    PageHinkley, HotellingT2, PcaSpeQ
  Robust statistics (3):
    RobustZMad, Hampel, TukeyFence
  Distribution distance / divergence (9):
    KolmogorovSmirnov, AndersonDarling, CramerVonMises,
    Wasserstein, EnergyDistance, Hellinger, KullbackLeibler,
    JensenShannon, PopulationStabilityIndex
  Trend / change-point (4):
    MannKendall, Pettitt, Snht, Mosum
  Spectral / signal (4):
    FftBandEnergy, SpectralEntropy, WaveletEnergy,
    AutocorrelationBreak
  Data quality (5):
    MissingnessSpike, MissingnessCoupling, CardinalityDrift,
    UniquenessViolation, FunctionalDependencyViolation
  Debug / observability (4):
    LatencyRamp, ErrorBurst, SlewShock, FanoutCascade
  Industrial / FDD (4):
    ResidualEnvelopeExit, SensorBias, ActuatorStiction,
    ValveHunting
  RF / communications (2):
    CarrierFrequencyOffset, EvmAnomaly

  TOTAL: 43 families.

The order is panel-locked. Acceptance test
`detector_family_order_is_stable` pins that
`DetectorFamily::all().len() == 43`,
`DetectorFamily::all()[0] == Shewhart`,
`DetectorFamily::all()[42] == EvmAnomaly`,
and `DetectorFamily::LatencyRamp.family_id() == FamilyId(33)`.

================================================================
Section 3 — Sample DetectorTemplate values
================================================================

S1.1 ships ONE worked example template (and the corresponding
`DetectorSpec`) in `tests/algebra_template_spec.rs`:

  DetectorTemplate {
    family:               RobustZMad,
    primitive_id:         Some(DetectorCanonicalId(101)),
    default_transform:    Residual,
    default_statistic:    Mad,
    default_comparator:   TwoSided,
    default_gate:         None,
    default_window:       W64,
    default_persistence:  3,
    default_axis_binding: Axis1 (residual magnitude),
    domain_tags:          {TimeSeries},
    cost_class:           Light,
    numeric_mode:         Q16_16,
    implementation_kind:  ScalarCpu,
  }

The template verifies clean. The verifier rejects:
  - primitive_id = None (TemplateMissingPrimitiveId)
  - default_window.cells = 0 (InvalidWindowCells)
  - default_axis_binding empty (EmptyAxisBinding)
  - domain_tags empty (EmptyDomainTagSet)

================================================================
Section 4 — Sample DetectorSpec values
================================================================

The same template, expanded into one concrete `DetectorSpec`:

  DetectorSpec {
    detector_id:           DetectorId(0),
    parameterization_id:   ParameterizationId(0),
    family:                RobustZMad,
    transform:             Residual,
    window:                W64,
    statistic:             Mad,
    comparator:            TwoSided,
    gate:                  Persistence,
    persistence_windows:   3,
    axis_binding:          Axis1,
    domain_tags:           {TimeSeries},
    cost_class:            Light,
    numeric_mode:          Q16_16,
    implementation_kind:   ScalarCpu,
    parameter_hash:        [0xAB; 32]  (synthetic; real generator
                                        in S1.2 computes SHA-256
                                        over the canonical param
                                        tuple),
    primitive_id:          Some(DetectorCanonicalId(101)),
    corpus_binding_status: PreHashT9InternalAudit,
    canonical_name:        ROBUST_Z_MAD__RESIDUAL__W64__MAD__TWO_SIDED__P3,
  }

The spec verifies clean. The verifier rejects:
  - parameter_hash = [0; 32] (SpecMissingParameterHash sentinel)
  - corpus_binding_status = HashFrozenT10 with source_corpus_hash
    = [0; 32] (SpecHashFrozenWithoutT10 -- post-T.10 cross-field
    rule: HashFrozenT10 <-> source_corpus_hash != [0; 32]; see
    the registry crate's verify.rs for the live rule)
  - empty axis_binding / empty domain_tags
  - window.cells = 0 / persistence_windows = 0
  - canonical_name token count != 6 (CanonicalNameWrongTokenCount)
  - canonical_name with any empty token (CanonicalNameHasEmptyToken)

================================================================
Section 5 — Domain tags represented
================================================================

  Debug, Telemetry, Tabular, TimeSeries, Graph, Industrial,
  Categorical, Missingness, EventStream, Medical, RfComms,
  Chemometrics, Database  (13 tags).

Bit positions are byte-identical to the corpus crate's
`dsfb_gpu_atlas_corpus::types::DomainTagSet`. Pinned by acceptance
test `domain_tagset_bit_positions_match_corpus_byte_for_byte`.

================================================================
Section 6 — Axis bindings represented
================================================================

The v1 9-axis fusion layout:

  Axis 1 — residual magnitude
  Axis 2 — drift persistence
  Axis 3 — slew shock
  Axis 4 — temporal locality
  Axis 5 — entity locality
  Axis 6 — causal / topological adjacency
  Axis 7 — detector motif consensus
  Axis 8 — bank semantic admissibility
  Axis 9 — confuser suppression

Section S Phase 1+ expands to an 8-plane × 8-axis hierarchy via
the corpus crate's [`dsfb_gpu_atlas_corpus::fusion`]; S1.1 only
declares the v1 9-axis binding.

================================================================
Section 7 — Pinned defaults
================================================================

  NumericMode::AUDIT_DEFAULT       = Q16_16
  ImplementationKind::DEFAULT      = ScalarCpu
  CorpusBindingStatus::S1_1_DEFAULT = PreHashT9InternalAudit
  Gate::None                       (default firing gate)
  CostClass::Light                 (default cost class)

Pinned by acceptance tests
`numeric_mode_defaults_to_q16_16_for_audit` and
`implementation_kind_is_not_gpu_claim_by_default`.

================================================================
Section 8 — Explicit non-claims
================================================================

S1.1 makes NO claim that any of the following exists or has been
done:

  - The 2,000-detector registry. (Reserved for S1.2.)
  - registry_hash_v2. (Reserved for S1.2.)
  - corpus_hash_v1. (Reserved for T.10.)
  - CaseFileV2 integration. (Reserved for T.11.)
  - Atlas family-kernel CUDA execution. (Reserved for S1.4+.)
  - NVRTC / JIT Mode B. (Reserved for Section S Phase 5+.)
  - Detector Delta Ledger writes. (Reserved for T.8 measured
    rows + Section S Phase 4+.)
  - D512 / D1024 / D2000 ladder. (Honestly deferred per the
    R.9.d.2.1 closure block.)
  - Atlas activation planner. (Reserved for S1.3+.)
  - Atlas paper headline. (Reserved for the post-Phase-6 paper
    `dsfb_gpu_atlas.tex`.)

================================================================
Section 9 — Ladder unchanged
================================================================

The D16 / D64 / D128 / D205 ladder is unchanged by S1.1.

  D16  -- CPU + GPU audit path (legacy).
  D64  -- CPU + GPU; R.13 ~55x full-pipeline campaign reduction
          headline at 256x4096 K=64.
  D128 -- CPU + GPU scaling-ladder proof (R.9.d.1).
  D205 -- CPU + GPU byte-equivalent (R.9.d.2 + R.9.d.2.1).

Pinned R.12b D64 saturation baseline at reports/r12_d64_saturation.txt
is byte-stable across S1.1; this commit does NOT rebaseline it.

================================================================
Closing statement
================================================================

The S1.1 commit lands the grammar plate. The factory (S1.2
registry generation) is a separate future commit gated on T.10
corpus_hash_v1. S1.1 is the algebra-types-only step that lets
Atlas architecture begin without prematurely freezing the
corpus.
